annotations.title: Check a power tree: regulator load, headroom and heat

description: Walk a board's power tree from your numbers: the current on every rail (its loads plus the input current of each regulator fed from it), each regulator's output current against its rating, a linear regulator's headroom above dropout, dissipation and junction temperature, and the total current against what the source can deliver (for example a USB-C contract). A check is made only when its inputs are given: no dropout, efficiency, thermal resistance or limit is assumed, and a switching regulator without an efficiency is refused. DC budget only: no inrush, load steps or sequencing. This differs from datasheetvend_estimate_power_budget, which totals extracted chips' supply current for an account's jobs. Free with a DatasheetVend API key (no credits), no model call, reads no account data, stores nothing.

rail.description: Net name exactly as the board names it, for example '+3V3'.

dropout_v.description: Linear only: dropout at the load current, from the datasheet.

efficiency.description: Switching only, required: 0 to 1, from the datasheet's curve at this load.

input_rail.description: Net name exactly as the board names it, for example '+3V3'.

output_rail.description: Net name exactly as the board names it, for example '+3V3'.

ref.description: Reference designator on the board, for example 'U3'.

rail.description: Net name exactly as the board names it, for example '+3V3'.
